statement.text: Let $d \geq 3$ be an odd integer. Give bounds on $\nu(d)$ such that if $n > \nu(d)$ the following is true: given any homogeneous polynomial $F(\mathbf{x}) \in \mathbb{Z}[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ of degree $d$, there is some $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{Z}^n \setminus \{\mathbf{0}\}$ such that $F(\mathbf{x}) = 0$.

title: Bounds for Homogeneous Polynomial Zeros
